advice_items.quote: work hard
advice_items.summary_en: Work hard early on to build your wealth foundation.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持努力工作，夯实财富基础

advice_items.quote: make conservative Investments a lot of people make a lot of money a lot of those people don't keep a lot of money
advice_items.summary_en: Make conservative investments because many people make money, but fail to keep it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保守稳健投资，守住赚到的财富

guests.first_money_or_break: 长期深耕华尔街股市与金融行业，30多岁末期成为百万富翁，巅峰期单年收入达八位数美元。
guests.guest_name: Marina District Wall Street Finance Veteran
guests.role_or_title: Wall Street / Stock Market Finance Professional
guests.zero_start_advice: 努力工作并做稳健保守的投资；很多人能赚到钱，但守不住钱。

advice_items.quote: don't listen to anybody else
advice_items.summary_en: Ignore outside naysayers and trust your own conviction.
advice_items.summary_zh: 屏蔽外界质疑，坚持自己的判断

advice_items.quote: find something you love to do and do it over and over again until you find product Market fit and you have to have conviction
advice_items.summary_en: Do something you genuinely love with real conviction and iterate until you find product-market fit.
advice_items.summary_zh: 热爱并坚守信念，打磨出市场契合

advice_items.quote: you got to lose a lot of money and make money
advice_items.summary_en: Accept losing money and enduring tough payroll moments as part of entrepreneurship.
advice_items.summary_zh: 接受创业中的亏损与低谷期考验

advice_items.quote: the best way to sell something is not to sell it I think if you get too wrapped up in the outcome it's over
advice_items.summary_en: In sales and negotiation, don't get too attached to the outcome; avoid pushing too hard.
advice_items.summary_zh: 销售谈判别过度执着于最终结果

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: AI cuz it's the internet of today
advice_items.summary_en: Enter artificial intelligence because it represents the foundational tech wave of today.
advice_items.summary_zh: 顺应时代浪潮，切入AI核心赛道

guests.first_money_or_break: 从未上过大学，连续创办七家公司并多次成功退出，如今经营AI公司Cantina，单年公司营收最高达5000万美元。
guests.zero_start_advice: 别听信他人质疑，找到热爱的事并反复打磨直到实现产品市场契合；谈判销售别太执着结果，当前应切入AI赛道。

advice_items.quote: you have to be comfortable with the risk of things going to zero and five of them are going to pay off 100 fold
advice_items.summary_en: Be comfortable with most bets going to zero in venture capital, knowing a few winners will pay off 100x.
advice_items.summary_zh: 理解风投幂律，敢于承担归零风险

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: started saving my money I got good jobs I moved around yeah so I just hustled
advice_items.summary_en: Save money early, land good jobs, stay mobile for opportunity, and hustle relentlessly.
advice_items.summary_zh: 早期坚持储蓄并全力拼搏积累

advice_items.quote: the more hands you shake the more money you make
advice_items.summary_en: Don't stay isolated working from home; get out and network because more connections create more wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 走出家门多社交，人脉决定财路

advice_items.quote: they can't scale because they won't hire a players and they won't hire good people around them and they won't delegate
advice_items.summary_en: Scale by hiring A-players who can do the job better than you and delegating real responsibility.
advice_items.summary_zh: 招募A级人才并充分放权才能扩张

advice_items.quote: you got to be a sponge absorb information
advice_items.summary_en: Act like a sponge and constantly absorb information and learn.
advice_items.summary_zh: 像海绵一样不断吸收新信息学习

advice_items.quote: don't worry about making mistakes everybody worries about making mistakes
advice_items.summary_en: Stop letting the fear of making mistakes hold you back.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别害怕犯错，放下顾虑勇敢试错

guests.first_money_or_break: 28岁通过储蓄、换取优质工作与拼搏成为百万富翁；后自筹资金创办RxList并在三年半后以33倍回报卖给WebMD，又推动Medable估值升至21亿美元。
guests.role_or_title: Venture Capitalist & Founder of RxList / Medable
guests.wealth_detail: Millionaire at 28; sold RxList (33x); Medable at $2.1B valuation (close to billionaire)
guests.zero_start_advice: 早年多储蓄并抓住好工作机会，多出门社交握手积累人脉；创业后聘请比自己更强的A级人才并学会放权，像海绵一样学习且不怕犯错。

advice_items.quote: it's on the buy not the sell actually yeah you always want to make the best deal on the buy otherwise the exit's easy
advice_items.summary_en: Make your money when you buy real estate rather than relying on the sell, so the exit is easy.
advice_items.summary_zh: 地产投资赚在买入，低买才好退出

advice_items.quote: make sure you're negotiating with the other principal don't let anybody get in the middle of your deal
advice_items.summary_en: Negotiate directly with the principal buyer or seller without letting middlemen get in the way.
advice_items.summary_zh: 直接与核心决策者谈判，剔除中介

advice_items.quote: just keep your head down and you just got to keep plowing through it
advice_items.summary_en: During market downturns, keep your head down, work hard, and plow through adversity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 遭遇低谷时沉住气低头苦干熬过去

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Buy During Forced Selling & Low Prices
advice_items.quote: when people are selling that's the time to buy
advice_items.summary_en: Buy real estate when people need to get out and heavy selling drives prices to their lowest.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在市场抛售潮价格最低时果断买入

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: that's the only way to buy real estate is leveraging... you cannot over leverage
advice_items.summary_en: Use debt leverage to acquire real estate, but never over-leverage yourself.
advice_items.summary_zh: 买地产须用杠杆但切忌过度负债

advice_items.quote: keep myself healthy that's really key is to be healthy and stay healthy don't spend your time partying
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize staying healthy, skip endless partying, and stay disciplined and focused on business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持身体健康自律，戒掉无效派对

advice_items.quote: keep your head down work hard and have faith in God
advice_items.summary_en: Stay humble, work hard, and maintain strong faith in God.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持信仰与敬畏，沉下心努力工作

guests.first_money_or_break: 专注于商业地产（公寓、办公楼与零售物业），38岁成为百万富翁，名下拥有约10万平方英尺地产，个人峰值年收入50万美元、公司年营收约100万美元。
guests.guest_name: Financial District Commercial Real Estate Investor
guests.wealth_detail: Millionaire at 38; $500k/yr personal income, $1M/yr business revenue; owns ~100,000 sq ft
guests.zero_start_advice: 地产赚钱在买入环节，趁他人急售低价时买进并直接与对方本人谈判；善用杠杆但勿过度负债，低谷期保持健康自律、低头苦干与信仰。
